title: Managed identity provider and invite acceptance
decision_needed: Compare OIDC providers and account lifecycle, signed invitation acceptance, CSRF/session protections
current_safe_default: Do not implement custom password storage by default

title: Opaque identifiers and tenant relational keys
decision_needed: Choose UUID/ULID strategy, tenant compound FK/indexes and per-table constraints
current_safe_default: Keep P1.07 fake IDs illustrative; never migrate actual data now

title: Fine-grained record permissions
decision_needed: Freeze team/agent relationship keys, owner-role grant rules, field projections and post-revocation policy
current_safe_default: Default deny; no blanket owner/admin reads

title: Merchant application states
decision_needed: Validate actual ISO, POS reseller and PayFac stage/status language with real operators
current_safe_default: Retain provisional demo-only stages; no processor authority
proposed_decision_owner: Product owner with domain operator evidence

title: Event delivery runtime
decision_needed: Choose outbox implementation, worker queue tech, dedup retention, ordering, dead-letter alerts

title: CSV import/export storage and security
decision_needed: Define upload scanning, bounded file formats, private export, revocation/expiry, audit
current_safe_default: Disable file endpoints until controls exist

title: NFR benchmarks and deployment environment
decision_needed: Choose staging/CI/hosting, synthetic load dataset, backup/restore and a11y test tooling

title: Market validation and partner evidence
decision_needed: Actual buyer/value, 5 pricing buyer interviews, 2 pilot commitments, 3 workflow checks
current_safe_default: Internal waiver is not commercialization validation

title: Real billing/legal/tax vendor selection
decision_needed: Approve billing vendor, geography/taxes, subscriber/refund/legal terms, data processing terms
current_safe_default: Mock only; no real charges or subscription setup
proposed_decision_owner: Product owner and legal reviewer if needed

title: Hosting region, retention and privacy policies
decision_needed: Decide real-data categories, residency, deletion, DPA vendor/security reviews
proposed_decision_owner: Product owner; independent reviewer if appropriate

title: Feature-specific executable QA allocation
decision_needed: Choose test runner, CI requirements, mapping feature cases to actual tests/critical pathways
current_safe_default: 727 planning cases do not imply execution

title: R0/R1/R2 pilot scope and product branding
decision_needed: Determine future real customer trial shape, brand/name, offer/package and measured outcome
current_safe_default: No Zoho-brand copying/parity claims or public launch without approval
